title: A TUI in this crate
body: Decided: the TUI lives in this crate behind a cargo feature named tui that is on by default, so cargo install gets it and --no-default-features gives a slim binary for hooks and CI. Internals stay private: --json is the extension point for anyone else's front end, because the lease, compare-and-swap and merge rules live in store.rs and cmd.rs and a library caller could skip them. With the feature on, bare foam launches the TUI when stdin and stdout are both terminals; piped, under a hook, or with the feature off it prints the help as it does today, so no script or agent ever lands in a screen.
